rotation.method: ORCHESTRATOR OVERRIDE (unattended, no WebSearch in planning): ALL 3 core + ALL 42 pool keywords are the working set, grouped into multi-keyword queries. Date rotation only sets the naming order: day-of-year 288 mod 42 = offset 36, so pool[36..41] come first, then pool[0..35].

Do not run those again. Only NEW checkout launches (other retailers, PSPs, Visa/Mastercard live rollouts with numbers) count.

Meta Advantage+ / AI creative automation ads: Meta business assistant upgrade, Advantage+ static-to-video GA, Ads Creative Studio expansion, Meta Ads MCP server, Messenger Business Agent checkout (10-14). Skip more coverage of that announcement bundle.
AI CRM pipeline / AI sales automation: Salesforce Koa CRM reasoning model (10-14). Skip Koa follow-ups; other Agentforce/HubSpot/Dynamics sales-agent launches with customer data are fine.
AI ad measurement / dynamic creative optimization: Bannerflow attention scoring (10-14) and DoubleVerify/Weight Watchers ChatGPT ads CPA (recent). Skip both.

rotation.scope_note: Follow sources.json categories[marketing]._note. Keep a story only if AI is what makes it AND it touches buying or selling ads or selling products. Search counts only where paid placement is involved. Exclude pure SEO plumbing, general search features, moderation infra, publisher licensing, funding, M&A, hires, awards, vendor advertorials and agency-internal ops.

plan_notes: LIBRARIAN: (1) Lead with outlet RSS / sitemap_news.xml feeds for recency: ppc.land, digiday.com, adexchanger.com, adweek.com, marketingdive.com, seroundtable.com, searchenginejournal.com, modernretail.co, retaildive.com, techcrunch.com, theverge.com, blog.google (ads), about.fb.com, newsroom.tiktok.com, press.aboutamazon.com. Search Engine Land, Ad Age, The Drum, MediaPost, Marketing Brew and Campaign are hard-blocked; reach their stories via RSS or the same news at another outlet. Use WebSearch ONLY to fill gaps after the feeds (site: search returns evergreen pages). (2) Window is 72h: keep items published 2026-10-12T00:00 to 2026-10-15 (KST) and verify each published time from the page. (3) Apply sources.json categories[marketing]._note strictly: AI must make the story AND it must touch ad buying/selling or product selling. Drop SEO plumbing, funding/M&A/hires/awards and vendor advertorials; read the body before keeping keyword-matched items. (4) Skip the deprioritized stories above; follow-ups only if they report a new launch, data or decision. (5) Check cross-section duplicates (agentic commerce stories can also land in gadgets/politics). (6) Write candidates under the key "items".
